tools.name: analyze_sentiment
tools.description: Sentiment analysis of a Thai or English message: score -1..1, label, confidence, detected signals and whether it needs attention (escalation words).

tools.name: assess_portfolio_risk
tools.description: Ranks the riskiest customers in the portfolio (candidates from the churn model) with a full risk score each, plus a summary (average, P90, count per level).

tools.name: calculate_customer_risk
tools.description: Calculates the overall account risk score (0-100) of one customer by combining churn probability (ML), SLA breach ratio and aging of open issues (IssueTracking), negative chat sentiment, contract expiry, overdue follow-ups and contact gap. Returns the level (Low/Medium/High/Critical), each factor value and the top contributors.

tools.name: calculate_sla_targets
tools.description: Calculates SLA response and resolution due dates for a customer and one of its severity codes, honoring the policy's business hours, working days and holidays.

severityCode.description: Severity code defined in the customer's SLA, e.g. S1

tools.name: create_customer_request
tools.description: Records a new customer request (Request, Tor, ChangeRequest or Incident). Incidents require a severity code from the customer's SLA. Does not forward it to other systems. Requires request.write.

tools.name: create_follow_up
tools.description: Creates a follow-up activity (call, email, task, visit, note) for a customer, owned by the current user, with a reminder 30 minutes before. Requires activity.write.

kind.description: Call, Email, Task, Visit or Note (meetings are created through the API with attendees)

tools.name: forecast_renewals
tools.description: Forecasts maintenance (MA) contract renewals ending within N days: renewal probability, expected renewal value, upsell/expansion probability and suggested upsell item.

withinDays.description: Contracts ending within this many days (1-730)

tools.name: forecast_sales
tools.description: Sales forecast per month (Holt-Winters on purchase history + weighted open pipeline) with ~80% confidence band and monthly seasonal index.

tools.name: forecast_seasonal_budget
tools.description: Seasonal budget forecast of one customer: expected spend per month and the seasonal index (1.0 = average month) to time proposals with the customer's budget cycle.

tools.name: get_best_send_time
tools.description: Send-time optimization: best day/hour (customer's local time) to send a message on a channel, the next send time and expected open rate.

tools.name: get_customer_360
tools.description: Customer 360 view: profile, relationships (people/companies and positions), channel identities, recent conversations, open activities, requests, open opportunities and links to projects/issues.

tools.name: get_customer_agenda
tools.description: Customer agenda: upcoming meetings (MessageHub), pending agenda items carried from past meetings, open activities and overdue count.

tools.name: get_issue_aging
tools.description: Summary of open issues in IssueTracking by aging bucket and customer-specific severity, SLA breached/at-risk counts and the oldest issues. Leave customerCode empty for all customers.

tools.name: get_pipeline_summary
tools.description: Sales pipeline summary per stage: count, amount, weighted amount, average days in stage and win rate (12 months).

tools.name: get_project_portfolio
tools.description: Active and closed projects of a customer from ProjectMgnt with phase, actual vs planned progress, health and forecast end date.

tools.name: get_sla_compliance
tools.description: SLA compliance of a customer: issues met/breached/at-risk/on-track and compliance percentage per severity level.

tools.name: get_sla_policy
tools.description: Effective SLA policy of a customer (customer-specific or the default): business hours, holidays and the customer-defined severity levels with response/resolution minutes.

tools.name: list_customer_requests
tools.description: Lists customer requests / TOR / change requests / incidents with status.

status.description: New, UnderReview, Approved, Forwarded, Rejected, Closed

tools.name: predict_churn
tools.description: Predicts churn probability (logistic regression trained on churned vs. active customers) with the signals that drive it and a recommended retention action. Leave customerCode empty to rank all active customers.

minProbability.description: Only return customers with probability >= this value (0..1)

tools.name: recommend_next_best_action
tools.description: Recommends the next best actions for a customer (respond to complaint, retention call, renewal, follow-up, discovery meeting, check-in, offer) with reason, priority, channel and best send time.

tools.name: recommend_products
tools.description: Product, service or content recommendations for a customer (item-based collaborative filtering on purchases and views, popularity fallback).

kind.description: Filter: Product, Service, Content or Promotion

tools.name: score_leads
tools.description: Predictive lead scoring: probability (0-100) that each open opportunity will be won, grade A-D and the factors behind the score.

tools.name: search_customers
tools.description: Searches customers (persons or juristic persons) by name, code, email or legal name, with optional filters.

tools.name: segment_customers
tools.description: Dynamic segmentation (RFM + engagement, k-means++): segment names (Champions, Loyal, At Risk, ...), sizes and centroids. Does not modify customers.
